segments.name: Billboard
segments.description: Sells advertising space on billboard displays along heavily traveled highways and roadways in U.S. markets to advertisers and brands.
segments.evidence: Digital billboard displays generate approximately four to five times more revenue per display on average than comparable traditional static billboard displays.

segments.name: Transit
segments.description: Sells advertising space on transit displays under exclusive multi-year contracts with municipalities in large U.S. cities to advertisers.
segments.evidence: Revenues generated on our network of digital transit displays are generally higher than revenues generated on a comparable portfolio of our static transit displays.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay for advertising space on billboard and transit displays, and for value-added services such as print production and creative services.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to leasing displays, we provide other value-added services to our customers, such as pre-campaign category research, consumer insights, print production, creative services and post-campaign tracking and analytics.

changes.text: The Canadian Business, which had comprised the International operating segment included in Other, was sold in 2024.
changes.evidence: On June 7, 2024, the Company completed the sale of the Canadian Business in the Transaction.
